vibe: Cinematic, moody, luxury editorial, like Spider-Man site meets Zara. Heavy negative space, slow fluid motion.

spacing_and_layout.general: Massive negative space. Components should breathe. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding.
spacing_and_layout.grid: Bento for features, strict 4-column minimal grid for product catalog (mobile 1-2 col).
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-aligned for paragraphs, asymmetric placement for images to feel like an editorial layout.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY. Feels heavy and momentum-based.
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Framer Motion useScroll/useTransform to move hero images slower than page scroll.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Slow lerp fades, 0.8s to 1.2s ease-in-out. Fade and slightly slide up on entry.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Image zoom on hover (scale 1.05) with caption reveal. Minimalist custom cursor dot follower.
motion_and_interactions.sticky: Scroll-pinned sections that lock in place while content flows past.
motion_and_interactions.emojis: FORBIDDEN. No emojis anywhere, no emoji hands, zero emojis.

components.navbar: Glassmorphism/Crystal variant but very dark (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Hidden on scroll down, reveals on scroll up. Minimalist links.
components.hero: Cinematic parallax hero. Full-bleed background. Huge 'SQZ' text with kinetic kerning. Slogan in clean sans overlay.
components.marquee: Infinite marquee using Instrument Serif, italicized in parts. Thin borders.
components.product_card: No borders, no shadows. Full bleed image wrapper, text below is small and uppercase. Hover reveals color variants.
components.sobre_nos: Split layout. One side sticky image, other side scrolling text.
components.footer: Minimalist editorial footer. Py-32. Huge brand logotype.

media.hero_background_description: Hyper-realistic glowing lemon slice in dark infinite space. Used to drive the cinematic Spider-man vibe with parallax.
media.editorial_jewelry_description: Cinematic portrait of luxury jewelry on model.
media.product_ring_macro_description: Macro shot of silver ring on dark rock.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: Setup project in Javascript (.jsx/.js files). NO TYPE SCRIPT.
Install and setup 'lenis' for smooth scrolling.
Install 'framer-motion' for all scroll reveals, parallax (useScroll, useTransform).
Use raw HTML + Tailwind CSS. Avoid Shadcn components for marketing layout structure, build custom grid systems.
Import 'Instrument Serif' and 'Manrope' fonts from Google Fonts via css @import.
Set global body background to #0A0A0A and text to #F5F5F0.
Create a cinematic hero with the provided generated lemon image scaling down on scroll.
Design 'Produtos' grid strictly to a 4-col minimalist grid like Zara.
Zero emojis in the entire application.
Ensure 'data-testid' is present on all interactive elements.
